subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should normal-channel `inbound_claim` be expanded beyond plugin-owned conversation bindings, or should this issue be split so only Feishu outbound hook parity is fixed here?
rationale: The Feishu outbound `message_sending` bypass is a source-reproducible bug, but allowing plugins to claim ordinary inbound channel traffic changes pre-routing authority, ordering, and security semantics for all channel messages.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix the Feishu outbound dispatcher hook gap under the existing outbound-hook cluster and track normal `inbound_claim` expansion as a separate plugin API/security contract.

options.title: Fold outbound work into canonical hook trackers
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92374 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50126 as the outbound-hook owners, preserving this issue only for Feishu evidence and inbound-claim semantics.

options.title: Solve all hook requests together
options.body: Land one broader PR for Feishu outbound hooks and normal-channel `inbound_claim`, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix the Feishu outbound dispatcher hook gap under the existing outbound-hook cluster and track normal `inbound_claim` expansion as a separate plugin API/security contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest direct history on inbound-claim observer semantics and is therefore the best available owner for the claim-authority decision.
